title: Namely pricing - $9/employee/month entry tier, custom quote for higher tiers
clean_text: Namely uses a per-employee-per-month subscription model with all features included at each tier and no extra fees beyond the quoted rate. The entry-level Namely Now plan starts at $9 per employee per month. Higher tiers -- Namely Plus (adds payroll, talent, time), Namely Plus People (managed payroll and benefits), and Namely Complete (white-glove PEO) -- are custom-priced. Volume discounts are available for larger organizations with 500+ employees.
